metrics.spl: Mean over ALL episodes of success * shortest_path_length / max(shortest_path_length, executed_path_length)
metrics.path_efficiency: Mean path ratio conditioned on success WITHIN each seed; zero if no successes. Across-seed mean is not a pooled successful-episode mean.
metrics.dispersion: Sample SD across independent trained seeds, ddof=1

hash_semantics: Ordinary complete-file SHA for source_evidence_manifest; runtime config/protocol identities may use frozen self-field-zeroed hashing and are retained separately.
